name: alx-protocol
description: ALX Protocol monorepo — specification, reference implementations, CLI, and conformance tooling

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @alx-protocol/sdk run build && pnpm --filter @alx-protocol/adapters run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @alx-protocol/sdk run build && pnpm --filter @alx-protocol/adapters run typecheck
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:js && pnpm run lint:solidity
scripts.lint:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path reference-implementations/rust/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path reference-implementations/rust/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.lint:all: pnpm run lint && pnpm run lint:python && pnpm run lint:rust
scripts.schema:check: pnpm run verify:schemas && pnpm run verify:fixtures
scripts.test:integration: pnpm run build && pnpm run test:cli && pnpm run test:adapters
scripts.test:conformance:ts: pnpm --filter @alx-protocol/sdk run build && node conformance/bin/run.js --impl "node sdk/conformance-adapter.js"
scripts.verify:cross-language: pnpm --filter @alx-protocol/sdk run build && pnpm run build:conformance:rust && pnpm run test:conformance:ts && pnpm run test:conformance:python && pnpm run test:conformance:rust && pnpm run test:conformance:differential
scripts.test:extension: pnpm run test:extension:merkle && pnpm run test:extension:signing
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm --filter @alx-protocol/sdk run build && c8 --clean --all --check-coverage --per-file --lines 80 --functions 70 --branches 70 --statements 80 --include sdk/dist/canonicalization.js --include sdk/dist/block.js --include sdk/dist/block-lineage.js --include sdk/dist/block-trace.js node --test tests/unit tests/security
scripts.test:mutation: pnpm --filter @alx-protocol/sdk run build && stryker run stryker.config.json
scripts.verify:protocol: pnpm run verify:suites && pnpm run verify:schemas && pnpm run verify:conformance-claims && pnpm run verify:protocol-version && pnpm run verify:fixtures && pnpm run protocol:checksums:check && pnpm run test:conformance
